paper_use_rule: Market-driven clean energy helps but does not create a 100 Gt/year AETHER power system.
Dedicated corridors move AETHER into tens of Gt/year, but still fail the full 100 Gt/year gate.
Firm clean colocation improves load service but remains below 100 Gt/year in this screen.
Only an upper-tail clean-energy abundance case clears the representative regional dispatch screen.
